title: Export current-page order and receipt count groups to PDF
description: A sales user downloads the selected current-page count grouping with the existing two-section customer order and unlinked-receipt evidence PDF. Reuse ERP-170 groups and the authorized bounded PDF request, current-user sales-order menu, salesperson scope and HTTP audit. Render separate order and receipt count sections only for a supported non-none mode; retain the original default document, pagination and explicit missing-font failure. Preserve unknown, inapplicable and truncation states; do not sum amounts or infer links. Development only: no arbitrary SQL, direct model database access, schema/migrations, production SQL or real database execution, writes, secrets/.env changes, deployment or real-browser acceptance. Verify focused PDF tests and safe Release build/test.
acceptance_criteria: PDF export rejects invalid GroupBy before source reads and reuses the authorized bounded current-page preview; none mode retains the existing two-section document.

Supported grouping adds separate order-count and unlinked-receipt-count PDF sections with current-page labels, escaped text, visible empty/inapplicable/truncation states and no inferred amount or receipt matching.
PDF unit tests cover modes, denied access, missing font, long labels and pagination, empty/truncated groups and unchanged evidence sections; document scope and pass safe Release build/test.
